documents.title: Merchant Marine Circular MMC-215 Panama Oil Record Book and Emissions (Amendments and Guidelines)
documents.revision: Revision RB-1; revision log runs Dec 2010 to Mar 2026
documents.summary: Official book is the Oil Record Book and Emissions: Part I machinery space, Part II cargo/ballast (tankers), Part III air pollution (all ships). Para 5.4: ships of 400 GT and above also make ODS entries in Part III. Para 5.6.6: each use of the incinerator is recorded in the Garbage Record Book and in the ORB and Emissions Parts I and III. Para 5.6.7: entries signed by officer(s) in charge, pages by Master. Para 4.3: kept 3 years after last entry. Para 5.6.11 (amended Mar 2026): holding tanks not required but if fitted list them in IOPP 3.3. Para 5.8 (new Mar 2026): code usage list per Circ.736/Rev.2 ('only as recommendation'). The Part III text itself is a hyperlink to an internal file server and is NOT in the PDF.

documents.title: Marine Notice 56 MARPOL Oil Record Books
documents.revision: v1.2 (v1.0 first issue; v1.1 periodic update)
documents.summary: Parts I and II only (BMA books: Part I Revision 6, Part II Revision 3). Entries made on completion; checked by Chief Engineer or Master within 24 h; amendments endorsed by both CE/Master and the responsible officer; pages endorsed by the Master; dd-MONTH-yyyy; 3-year retention; C11.4/C12.2 guidance; D vs E is the mode of starting; sulphur content not required in ORB. BMA cautions against relying on Circ.736 and industry guidance (4.2.1).
